evaluation.protocol: fixed synthetic evidence packets; real authenticated NewsClaw SSE and configured model route; responseFormat=json_object; exact-function/none tool policy; server contract event plus independent strict adjudication

orchestration.interpretation: provider-enforced orchestration plus NewsClaw executor correctness; not autonomous model tool selection
orchestration.executionSemantics: required/function constrains exactly one initial assistant tool step; after the tool result NewsClaw switches to toolChoice=none for the terminal JSON-object answer

providerInvestigation.defaultThinkingMode: auto and none returned HTTP 200; required and exact-function returned HTTP 400 because forced tool choice is unsupported in thinking mode
providerInvestigation.thinkingDisabled: required and exact-function produced ai_news_event source_health calls
providerInvestigation.combinedExactFunctionAndJson: a direct provider request could finish without the required tool call, motivating the two-stage contract

badcases.rootCause: the model treated exact textual entailment from an untrusted lookalike host as trustworthy claim-to-quote support
the model selected the tier of the quote closest to the claim instead of the strongest source represented in the packet
the model let an out-of-packet citation request change the independent verification decision for otherwise direct official evidence
the model let an unresolved conflict change the quote-level support field even though one trustworthy quote directly entailed the requested claim

integrity.rawTraceRetention: local target directory only; raw SSE is excluded from Git

boundaries: Frozen synthetic evidence-policy labels are not human ratings of production user traffic.
The result does not establish open-web discovery accuracy, hallucination rate, user satisfaction, delivery success, QPS, capacity, SLA, production token cost, or production latency.
Run-level P50 and P95 describe one sequential controlled run only.
humanReviewRequested is a model decision label; persisted review tasks and production gating are evidenced by deterministic backend tests.
v3 tool metrics measure declared provider orchestration and executor behavior, not autonomous model tool selection.
